MOTH AROUND - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft).
Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Run MothAround.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.
LEFT / RIGHT (keyboard arrows or gamepad D-pad) steer around the lantern.
Slip through the gold-tipped openings in the closing leaf and cobweb rings.
Rings have one to three openings of varied widths, and their initial sizes vary.
Release to stop circling. Rings gradually speed up to a cap; later openings
gently rotate. Each pattern gives enough preview and turning time to stay reachable.
Each ring scores 10, a centred passage adds 3, and survival adds 1 per second.
One life, an endless garden, a best score to beat.

X / Z / C / V or a gamepad face button starts from the title. Arrows also start.
Enter starts, pauses and resumes. Backspace / Esc / Right Shift also pause.
After results, X or a gamepad face button returns to the title.
Players 2-4 join with A on the title and leave with B. P1 starts the game.
Players share one lantern, screen and the same inner orbit. All players face
identical ring timing; moths may overlap. Solo and multiplayer use smaller
moths closer to the lamp. P2 keyboard: A / D to steer,
H to join, G to leave, T Start, R Select. Gamepads work for up to four players.
F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen. F12 takes a screenshot.
Widescreen: the picture follows the shape of the window (drag its edges or go
fullscreen: a wider window shows more of the garden). To fix it: --width 427
(16:9), --width 520 (phones), or --aspect 4:3 for the classic 320x240.
Best scores are saved to motharound.srm next to the executable.
